subject: Breakout speakers: regional demos, CTA alignment, and hand-off
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya@brightfin.co>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Breakout speakers: regional demos, CTA alignment, and hand-off

Hey Maya — thanks again for agreeing to join the APAC breakout on Dec 9. A couple of quick items to lock down so we can finalize the run-of-show and the slide ingest: 

1) Availability & timing: the breakout is 30 minutes. We have 20 minutes scheduled for the demo + 10 minutes for live Q&A. Can you confirm you’re available for a dry-run with us the week of Dec 1? Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood/30m-webinar-technical-check

2) Demo segmentation: you mentioned showing a localized flows demo (payments -> reconciliation -> reporting). We want three 6-minute micro-demos mapped to US/EU/APAC pain points. If you prefer a single continuous demo, say so — we’ll adjust the script.

3) CTA & hand-off: the primary CTA for this breakout is a product trial + regional success call. We need a one-line CTA and the thank-you slide that links to BrightFin’s trial page. Lauren, can you align the CTA copy? Karthik — we’ll need the short redirect snippet for the post-webinar flow.

Attached: redwood-breakout-deck-v1.pptx (slide placeholders + proposed live-switch cues). Please reply with: a) dry-run availability, b) final demo outline, c) any slides to replace placeholders.

Thanks — Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-breakout-deck-v1.pptx (pptx, 4.8MB)]

From: Maya Chen <maya@brightfin.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: events@brightfin.co
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Breakout speakers: regional demos, CTA alignment, and hand-off

Thanks Priyom — quick answers inline.

> 1) Dry-run availability
We can do Tue Dec 2 at 10am PST or Thu Dec 4 at 3pm PST. Either works, prefer Dec 2.

> 2) Demo segmentation
I can split into three short demos: (1) pay-in reconciliation (APAC focus), (2) failure-handling + retries (EU), (3) reporting + dashboards (US). I’ll annotate which slides map to each segment and send final deck by Nov 30.

> 3) CTA & hand-off
One-line CTA suggestion: “Start a BrightFin trial and get a regional onboarding session within 2 weeks.”

Attached: small slide notes (PDF comments) and a sample CTA landing URL we use internally. Will send the full slide deck update by Monday Nov 30.

Maya
Head of Product Marketing, BrightFin
[attachment: maya-demo-notes.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

Nice — Maya’s outline looks great. A couple of operational asks before we lock slides: 

- CTA copy: I drafted two short variants and attached them (CTA-copy-v2.docx). Priyom / Karthik, pick the one that best maps to our measurement tags.
- Slide gating: we need final PPTX from BrightFin by Nov 30 EOD to make layout/accessibility fixes and add captions. Please confirm deliverable date in your reply to Maya.
- Demo checklist: I attached a condensed checklist (regional-demo-checklist.pdf) — includes mic test, captioning, backup video, and what to do if a live demo fails (fallback video + host speedrun).

Karthik — can you produce the 1-line redirect snippet and the UTM params? We want to ensure the CTA in the thank-you slide records trial source as "brightfin-breakout-12-09".

Thanks — Lauren

All — quick status and next steps to close this out: 

1) Dry-run booked: Tue Dec 2 10:00am PST (calendar invite sent). Maya — invite accepted noted, thank you.
2) Slides: Maya will deliver updated PPTX by Mon Nov 30 EOD. Lauren and I will do layout pass Dec 1 morning and add captions.
3) CTA: Lauren variant #2 approved. Karthik — please confirm the redirect snippet by EOD Nov 26 so we can add the link to the final slide. CTA label: "Start BrightFin Trial (regional onboarding)".
4) Backup plan: if the live demo has connection issues, host will play a 3-minute pre-recorded clip (file: backup-demo-apac.mp4). Vanessa — please ensure the host has the clip queued in the Greenscreen runbook.

Deliverables checklist (final):
- BrightFin updated PPTX (Nov 30 EOD)
- CTA redirect + UTM (Nov 26 EOD)
- Dry-run (Dec 2 10:00am PST)
- Backup clip uploaded to event drive (Dec 7 EOD)

Thanks team — I’ll ping again after the dry-run with a final run-of-show PDF and the thank-you slide URL.

Best,
